title: Maximum current expression
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct formula for the maximum induced current, I_m = nπ²a²B / (R+r).

title: Average EMF for quarter-turn
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the average induced EMF during a quarter-turn rotation as 2nπBa².

title: Charge through load resistor
description: Essential: The student must correctly derive the charge passing through R during a quarter-turn as πBa² / (2(R+r)).

title: External work for full rotation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the work done by the external force in one full rotation as n²B²π⁴a⁴ / (4(R+r)).

title: Apply Faraday's Law
description: Important: The student must use Faraday's law (Ē = ΔΦ/Δt) correctly to find the average EMF, identifying the correct ΔΦ for the quarter-turn.

title: Use flux change for charge
description: Important: The student must apply the relationship q = ΔΦ / (R_total) for the induced charge, using the total resistance (R+r).

title: Relate rotation to EMF
description: Important: The student must correctly relate rotational speed (n) to angular velocity (ω = 2πn) and maximum EMF (E_m = BSω).

title: Energy conservation for work
description: Important: The student must equate the external work to the Joule heat over one period, using the effective EMF (E = E_m/√2).

title: Incorrect resistance sum
description: Pitfall: The student uses only R or only r instead of the total resistance (R+r) in current, charge, or work formulas.

title: Confuse average and maximum
description: Pitfall: The student uses the maximum EMF formula where the average EMF is required, or vice-versa.
